title: Arkani-Hamed's positive geometries outside spacetime

tellings.quote: and what they're finding so Nemo was one of the first pioneers in this era um is structures that they call positive geometries outside of spaceime.

plain: Physicists led by Nima Arkani-Hamed at the Institute for Advanced Study in Princeton are said to be finding mathematical shapes, called positive geometries, that sit outside space and time and give rise to the laws of particle physics. The cognitive scientist Donald Hoffman describes this work to Michels, calling Arkani-Hamed "one of the first pioneers" of finding "structures that they call positive geometries outside of spacetime," and he also mentions the physicist David Gross. To Hoffman it means space and time are not the deepest layer of reality.
